The '''FT-3C Imperium''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] which performed in Strikefighter roles. Created in the shipyards of [[Dromund Kalakar]], the Imperium was derived from the similar [[F-T2 Quell]], though it was designed as a sensor-oriented coordinator starfighter.
